title: GTA6 Extended Look Tops Netflix Top 10 Chart in First Week
description: GTA 6: An Extended Look dominated Netflix's English Film category in its first week, racking up 31.1 million views despite debuting on a Thursday.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix Charts in Phenomenal First Week

The cultural footprint of Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to expand far beyond traditional gaming spheres. According to recent reports from IGN Games, *Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look* has made an explosive debut on streaming giant Netflix, capturing the top spot on the platform's English Film top 10 chart during its very first week.

### Staggering Viewership Numbers

Streaming metrics reveal that the special video presentation pulled in an impressive 31.1 million views in its opening week. This massive figure propelled it comfortably into the number one position, leaving its closest competitors trailing behind on the weekly global charts.

Securing the second-place spot on the list was the thriller film *The Whisper Man*, starring Robert DeNiro, Adam Scott, and Michelle Monaghan. While the star-studded psychological thriller managed a respectable 23.2 million views, it was ultimately no match for the unstoppable cultural momentum generated by the GTA franchise.

### A Late Debut Makes the Feat Even More Impressive

Perhaps the most striking detail regarding this streaming milestone is the timeline of the release. *GTA 6: An Extended Look* did not even premiere at the beginning of the standard tracking week, instead making its official platform debut on a Thursday.

Despite losing valuable days of potential viewing time compared to standard releases that launch at the start of the week, the content still managed to outpace all traditional cinematic and streaming competition. Achieving over 31 million views in a truncated window underscores the unprecedented level of mainstream anticipation surrounding the game.

### Editor's Take

Dominating Netflix's charts with 31.1 million views in just a few days proves that the hype for GTA6 transcends gaming. Pulling off this feat while launching mid-week makes the achievement even more staggering, highlighting just how deeply embedded the franchise is in modern pop culture.
